feeds.title: World Cement
feeds.description: The latest cement news from World Cement magazine a leading cement publication covering industry trends, cement production, product news, and special reports. Palladian Publications Limited is a family-run business with a heritage stretching back to 1947. Originally founded to report and convey information on the very latest innovations in general engineering to a mainly European audience, they quickly established a distinguished reputation for the quality of their magazines and journals.

feeds.title: Cement Products
feeds.description: Cement Products Magazine, from SEMCO Publishing, brings focus to issues affecting cementitious materials suppliers. SEMCO Publishing is the parent company of Rock Products, Cement Products, Concrete Products, The Asia Miner, and North American Mining magazines.

feeds.title: CemNet
feeds.description: Be the first to know the latest developments in the cement industry. Get the latest cement industry news and updates from the writers of International Cement Review Magazine. CemNet is the leading portal to the cement manufacturing sector, providing daily updated news, publications, conferences, training, podcasts, videos, forums, consultancy, and much more.

feeds.title: Global Cement
feeds.description: Global Cement Magazine covers all aspects of the cement industry online and in monthly printed issues. The precursor company to Pro Global Media Ltd was founded in October 1996 by Paul Brown, and Robert McCaffrey, to publish the original Asian Cement Magazine.

feeds.title: GCCA Association
feeds.description: The Global Cement and Concrete Association (GCCA) is the global voice for cement and concrete - the most widely used man-made product on the planet. The GCCA and its members are committed to promoting the unique properties of concrete as a sustainable, durable and resilient building material - a material that will answer the needs of a growing and increasingly urban population that is set to exceed 9 billion people by 2050. Get the latest news from the association, cement industry and more!

feeds.title: World Cement Association Blog
feeds.description: The World Cement Association aims to represent and promote the cement industry worldwide as well as the commercial and legal interests of its Members. The World Cement Association, founded in 2016, is the largest independent organization that works globally on behalf of the cement and clinker industry and its stakeholders.

feeds.title: CementIndustryReport.net
feeds.description: Ibis Research-which maintains this site - aims to track core industrial sectors. It records Cement industry news, updates, technology trends, and company profiles, updates address directories, tracks new project investments, posting updates on the latest development. It provides timely information, analysis and insights. This website tracks state government policies, job opportunities in the sector, industry climate and economy forecast etc.

feeds.title: Union Cement Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest news and stories about the construction industry and the Philippines' dependable cement brand. Union Cement by Philcement Corporation, a PHINMA company is a provider of cement products. In 1957, the newly-established PHINMA Corp., composed of visionary business executives who wanted to be part of the Philippines' march into the industrial age, acquired the Cebu Portland Cement Company.

feeds.title: Khadilkar Cement Blog
feeds.description: Over the years I have gained a lot of insight into Cement Manufacturing and Cement/Cementitious products while having worked on many innovative concepts. I believe now is the right time for me to share my experiences in the cement industry across the world. I have worked in the cement industry for more than 30 years.

feeds.title: Wonder Cement
feeds.description: Wonder Cement is India's leading and one of the fastest growing cement manufacturers and suppliers operating in almost every part of India.

feeds.title: AGICO Cement Blog
feeds.description: We are AGICO Cement International Engineering Co., Ltd., a cement plant project contractor and cement manufacturing equipment exporting company locates in Anyang, Henan Province, China.
